# The Cohesive Tetrad: Jalan Menuju Kebenaran — LLM Full Index

## 1) Canonical identity
- Title (ID): The Cohesive Tetrad: Jalan Menuju Kebenaran
- Title (EN): The Cohesive Tetrad: Sabda, Logic, Qualia, Mystica
- Tagline (ID): Akhir dari Perdebatan adalah Awal dari Amal
- Tagline (EN): The End of Debate is the Beginning of Deeds
- Author: Ade Zaenal Mutaqin
- DOI (OSF): https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/D5S7V
- Repository: https://github.com/suratkiade/the-cohesive-tetrad
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
- Languages: Indonesian (primary), English (secondary)

## 2) Canonical scope and rules
- This repository is the canonical public record for The Cohesive Tetrad.
- All derivatives, citations, and adaptations must reference this repository and the DOI.
- The semantic definitions in `semantic-defs/` are binding for all uses of Sabda, Logic, Qualia, Mystica, and Akhlak.
